text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the support received from the 
Three Goddesses so far, a wealth of useful 
knowledge has been gathered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each piece of knowledge connects within 
herself, coalescing into a brand-new body 
of wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Absorbing all this expanded knowledge and 
making it my own—now might be the exact 
time for that...!
